question: In which state is the 'Solung' festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Solung Festival**

 
 
• **​**The **Adis of Arunachal Pradesh celebrate Solung**, their most well-known festival, on **September 1 every year**, after the sowing of seeds in order to **pray for prosperity and a successful harvest.**
 
• It is primarily **an agricultural celebration** but exhibits the **socio-religious** characteristics of the populace.
 
• Additionally, **tribal people trade presents of meat and apong (rice beer).**
 
• Attending this festival is the best method to learn about the culture and socioeconomic importance of the Adi tribe.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The celebration of this** solung festival consists of three primary components.** As follows:

 
 
• **The main inaugural day, known as Sopi-Yekpi or Ardo-Bado,** is when pigs and mithuns are sacrificed and offered to Dadi Bote, the god of domestic animals.
 
• **Binyat is the second half of the festival**, during which the goddess of crops and food, Kine Nane, is worshipped.
 
• During the festival's last phase, **Ekop or Taktor, Miri, the singer leader, tells the story of Nibo or Abotani, the Tanis' forefather.**
